metadata.title: Newspaper Collage Portrait with Expressive Script

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait integrated into a dense newspaper clipping background with a bold, expressive red and black script overlay.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male portrait rendered in high-contrast black and white, where the skin and clothing textures are composed of layered, distressed newspaper columns. The background is a desaturated, off-white paper texture with faint, illegible newsprint. A large, aggressive hand-drawn script in red and black sits in the lower-left foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait features defined by varying densities of newsprint text
Aggressive script overlapping the subject's chest and neck
Monochrome subject contrasted against a single bold accent color
Rough, torn-edge paper aesthetic throughout the composition
coreInvariants: Newspaper text must be visible within the facial shadows and highlights
High-contrast lighting on the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central bust-up portrait occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large red script in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face down to the bold script, then following the diagonal stroke of the lettering across the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Moderate negative space around the head, filled with light, faded newsprint textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated off-white and grey (background and mid-tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black (shadows and secondary script stroke)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with zero saturation in the portrait, punctuated by high-saturation red.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Expressive, slanted cursive script with varying stroke widths.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy bottom-heavy weight on the main title
Dual-layering with a black offset shadow/stroke
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' features a long, sweeping descender
The '2' is stylized with a sharp, angular base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, expressive brush script paired with a smaller, cleaner secondary script and standard sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, fast-motion energy of the main title.
Matches the background texture for metadata elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast monochrome portrait of a man where the skin and clothes are textured with dense newspaper clippings. Place him against a light, distressed paper background with faint newsprint.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, aggressive hand-drawn script in the lower-left corner using a vibrant red fill with a black offset shadow, slanted upwards.

verificationChecks: Is the newspaper texture visible inside the portrait shadows?
Does the red script have a black secondary stroke or shadow?
Is the overall image high-contrast monochrome except for the red text?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the newspaper clippings
Specific brand logos or advisory stickers

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of text-texture on the face

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text texture follows the contours of the face.
Verify the red script is the most saturated element.
Check that the background feels like aged, recycled paper.
Confirm the high-contrast black and white balance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Newspaper Texture Overlay + High Contrast B&W + Aggressive Red Script Overlay
